items.prompt: Which response to a vanished float pivot preserves this exact reference algorithm's input contract?

options.text: Add jitter and report it as the original factor.
options.why: That changes A and conceals the change.

options.text: Round the input entries before factorization.
options.why: Input entries are already exact integers. Changing them would solve another matrix.

options.text: Keep original integers and compute rational LDL pivots.
options.why: The implementation never uses approximate pivots or modifies A; square-root display comes afterward.

options.text: Skip the row and output zero on its diagonal.
options.why: That need not reconstruct the supplied SPD matrix or satisfy its positive diagonal factor convention.

items.explanation: The implementation never uses approximate pivots or modifies A; square-root display comes afterward.
